title: How I'd make my first $500 with Claude
hook: How I'd make my first $500 with Claude

beats.say: I need five hundred dollars this month. Fast.
Don't sell AI. Sell a fixed problem. Local businesses lose customers when nobody replies fast.

panel.text: Sell the fix, not the AI

beats.say: So build a tiny lead follow up tool. A customer fills a form, gets a reply in a minute, and picks a time for a call.

panel.title: What the customer sees
bubbles: Hi, can I get a quote for Friday?
Absolutely! Want 10am or 2pm for a quick call?

beats.say: Describe it, build it in an afternoon, and test it on your own phone first. And keep every key on the server.

panel.label: You to Claude
panel.text: Build a small web form that emails me new leads, sends the customer an instant reply, and offers two call times. Keep it simple and secure: no API keys in the browser.

beats.say: Then offer it to five local businesses for a five hundred dollar setup. One yes hits your goal.
And if all five say no, I still learn what sells.
Start small. Ship it. Then ask for the sale.

cta: Comment MONEY for the full plan
caption: A realistic way to try for your first $500 with Claude: don't sell 'AI', sell a fixed problem. Build a tiny lead follow-up tool (form, instant reply, call booking) in an afternoon, test it on yourself, keep API keys on the server, then offer it to 5 local businesses for a $500 setup. This is example math, not a promise of income. The prompt is in the pinned comment. Building your own app? Use code AT100 on Base44 (link in bio).
